t: Intelligence Report - Political - General Situation January 28, 1929

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
CHIN Shanghai.
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. I. D. REGISTRY
No. L. O. D.: 4.........
January 28 1929.
Date....................

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Political

Sun Fo, Minister of Railways, left Shanghai North
for Nanking at 11 p.m. January 27.

Sun Yen Kai, President of the Administrative Yuan,
arrived from Nanking at the North Station at 8 a.m. January 28.

General Chiang Kai-shek is residing at 311 Rue de la Tour
(His own residence) during his stay here.

Seven members of the Directing Committee of the local
Kuomintang Headquarters held a meeting between 10 a.m. and
11.45 a.m. January 27, 1929, in their offices at Ling Ying
Road, West Gate. Wong Yien Seong, one of the number, presided.
The following resolutions were passed at the meeting :

1. That during the treaty negotiations now going on between
China and France, the National Government be requested to
endeavour to secure an abatement of taxes levied on Chinese
goods imported to Annam.

2. That efforts be made to restore the control of the
part of the railway connecting Yunnanfu and Haiphong.

3. That efforts be made to secure the abolition of poll tax
on Chinese residing in Annam and other oppressive taxes.

4. That the rights of opening mines in Yunnan and Kweichow, ceded
to France, be restored to China.

Captain Dung Ching-ming (鄧擎銘), one of General Hsiung
Shih-hui's adjutants, has been appointed as from January 27
Chief of the Intelligence Office attached to Headquarters of the
Defence Commissioner of Woosung & Shanghai vice Col. Kiang Tao-
yuen resigned.

It is learned from a reliable source that the French
Consular Authorities have requested the French smuggling gang
to use their influence to have Mr. Poullain, a French citizen,
appointed as Co-Director-General of Posts, instead of Mr.
Eriksson, a Swede and the most senior candidate for the post.

（批：Judged valuable copy kept）

日期：1929年1月28日

情报报告。
政治类

铁道部部长孙科于1月27日晚11时离开上海北站前往南京。

行政院院长孙传芳（Sun Yen Kai，音译）于1月28日上午8时从南京抵达北站。

蒋介石将军在沪期间寓居塔路311号（其私宅）。

国民党上海特别市党部指导委员会七名委员于1929年1月27日上午10时至11时45分，在西门灵隐路该党部办公室举行会议。委员之一王英生（Wong Yien Seong，音译）担任主席。会议通过以下决议：

1. 鉴于目前中法正在进行条约谈判，请国民政府努力争取减免输入安南（越南）的中国货物所征收的税款。

2. 努力恢复对连接云南府与海防之铁路路段的控制权。

3. 努力争取废除居住在安南及其他地区的中国人的人头税及其他苛捐杂税。

4. 收回此前割让给法国的云南及贵州开矿权。

熊式辉将军副官之一邓擎铭上尉，自1月27日起被任命为吴淞及上海防卫委员总部附属情报办公室主任，接替辞职的江道源（Kiang Tao-yuen，音译）上校。

据可靠消息来源称，法国领事当局已请求法国走私团伙利用其影响力，推举法国公民普兰先生（Mr. Poullain）出任邮政总局副局长，而非瑞典人埃里克森先生（Mr. Eriksson），后者是该职位资历最深的候选人。

（批注：判定为有价值副本，存档）

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
Shanghai, January 28 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
(political) 2

The ceremony of launching a Chinese new gunboat
named "Yungguan"(永綏) was held between 2 and 5 p.m.Jan.27
in the Kiangnan Dock,Nantao. Chen Shao Kwei(陳紹寬),
Commander of the Second Squadron, presided over the
function. There were in attendance about 300 Chinese
officials and others including General and Madame Chiang
Kai-shek, General Hsiung Shih-hui and Huang Tsung Hing,
Chief of the Shanghai Public Safety Bureau. This gunboat
is stated to have a length of 225 ft, breadth 31 ft, draught
6 ft and equipped with engines of 4,800 hp capable of
producing a speed of 19 knots. Its armaments are as
follows :-
1 big gun with 15 c.m. in calibre
1 big gun with 12 c.m. in calibre
3 guns with 7.5 c.m. in calibre
4 guns with 5.7 c.m. in calibre
6 machine guns.
This ship was constructed at a cost of $1,600,000.00.

It is reported that General Chiang Kai-shek's
mission to Shanghai is really to persuade the two
Admiral Chens of the Chinese Navy to withdraw their
resignation.

公共租界警务处。
刑事调查处。
上海，1929年1月28日。

情报报告。
（政治类） 2

一艘名为“永绥”的中国新炮艇下水仪式于1月27日下午2时至5时在南市江南造船厂举行。第二舰队司令陈绍宽主持了该仪式。约有300名中国官员及其他人士出席，包括蒋介石将军及夫人、熊式辉将军以及上海市公安局局长黄宗汉。据悉，该炮艇长225英尺，宽31英尺，吃水6英尺，配备功率为4,800马力的发动机，航速可达19节。其武器装备如下：
1门15厘米口径大炮
1门12厘米口径大炮
3门7.5厘米口径火炮
4门5.7厘米口径火炮
6挺机枪。
该船建造费用为1,600,000.00美元。

据报道，蒋介石将军此次上海之行的真实目的是劝说中国海军的陈氏两位 Admiral（上将/司令）撤回辞呈。

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
Shanghai, January 28, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Anti-Japanese Movement

Picketing groups belonging to Anti-Japanese Boycott Associa-
tion continued the search for Japanese goods in Chinese controlled
territory on January 27 and made the following seizures :-

11 a.m. Kwan Jiao 28 pairs overshoe.
6 blankets.
1 packet of toys.

2 p.m. Hwah Ha Kwoi Ka Three packets of marine products.
7 packets of sugar.

3 p.m. Nantao Bund 1 box of glass
4 bales of cotton yarn
2 bales of piece goods.

10.30 a.m. Singming Road 1 packet of white sugar
1 packet of marine product
1 packet of dried shrimps.

1.10 p.m. Hengfeng Road 10 pairs of overshoes
40 hats

3 p.m. Jukong Road 9 "Thermos" bottles
69 pieces of underwear.

3.40 p.m. Kiaotung Road 4 bales of cotton yarn
14 umbrellas

4 p.m. Tan Tsz Yan 20 lengths of piece goods
60 pairs overshoes
3 packets of marine products.

The first three seizures are detained in the City Chamber of
Commerce and the remainder in the Boycott Inspectors' Office
at No. 15 Tien Chi Li, Paoshan Road, Chapei.

上午11时 关桥（Kwan Jiao，音译） 雨鞋28双。
毛毯6条。
玩具1包。

下午2时 华华桂家（Hwah Ha Kwoi Ka，音译） 海产品3包。
糖7包。

下午3时 南市外滩 玻璃1箱
棉纱4包
匹头（布匹）2包。

上午10时30分 星明路（Singming Road，音译） 白糖1包
海产品1包
虾干1包。

下午1时10分 恒丰路 雨鞋10双
帽子40顶

下午3时 菊恭路（Jukong Road，音译） “膳魔师”保温瓶9个
内衣69件。

下午3时40分 胶东路（Kiaotung Road，音译） 棉纱4包
雨伞14把

下午4时 谭子岩（Tan Tsz Yan，音译） 匹头（布匹）20匹

前三批查获物品扣押在市商会，其余物品扣押在闸北宝山路天吉里15号的抵制日货检查员办公室。

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C: I. D.
Shanghai, January 28, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Labour

As a protest against the dismissal of a shroff, 1,000
female workers of the Pootung Factory of the B.A.T.Co., turned
up at 7 a.m. January 28, but refused to work and are still on
the factory premises.

Twenty eight representatives of local labour unions
including the Commercial Press Employees' Union, the Silk
Filature Employees' Union, and the Nantao Tramway Employees'
Union held a meeting between 2 and 3.30 p.m. January 27, 1929,
at No.7. Poh An Fang, Hsiang Shan Road, Chapei, to discuss
proposals for the commemoration of the 6th Anniversary of the
Peking-Hankow Railway Workers' Strike which occurred in 1923 when
a number of labour agitators were executed by Military
Authorities in Hupeh. Chu Shun Ping, (朱润斌), representative
of the Tea-making Store Employees' Union, presided. The
following resolutions were discussed and passed:-

1. That a commemorative meeting be held on February 7, 1929, at
a place to be fixed later.

2. That the local Kuomintang Headquarters be requested to send
a circular telegram to Kuomintang organs in various places
urging that similar commemorative meetings be held on that day

3. That a delegation of 3 persons be sent to Nanking to appeal
for a fund for the purpose of establishing a "February 7
Labour School".

4. That the National Government be requested to issue a warrant
for the arrest of Wu Pei Fu.

5. That handbills and posters be prepared for distribution at
the occasion.

Some thirty members of the Chinese Young Men's Lecturing
Group Society held a meeting between 10 and 11.30 a.m. Jan. 27,
in their headquarters at Chung Hwa Road, Nantao, to commemorate
the 12th anniversary

公共租界警务处。
C: I. D.
上海，1929年1月28日。

情报报告。
劳工类

为抗议一名收银员被解雇，英美烟草公司浦东工厂的1,000名女工于1月28日上午7时出现，但拒绝工作，目前仍停留在厂区内。

包括商务印书馆职工工会、丝厂职工工会和南市电车职工工会在内的本地工会二十八名代表，于1929年1月27日下午2时至3时30分，在闸北香山路保安坊7号举行会议，讨论纪念1923年京汉铁路工人罢工六周年的提案。那次罢工中，多名劳工煽动者在湖北被军事当局处决。茶业店员公会代表朱润斌担任主席。会议讨论并通过以下决议：

1. 于1929年2月7日举行纪念大会，地点待定。

2. 请国民党上海特别市党部向各地国民党机关发出通电信，敦促在当日举行类似的纪念活动。

3. 派遣三人代表团前往南京，呼吁拨款用于建立“二七劳工学校”。

4. 请国民政府发布逮捕吴佩孚的通缉令。

5. 印制传单和海报，以备届时分发。

中国青年演讲团社约三十名成员于1月27日上午10时至11时30分，在南市中华路该社总部举行会议，纪念其成立十二周年

pages.en:
MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.

Shanghai, January 28, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Russian

A group of 45 Russian ex-soldiers of Marshal Chang Chung
Chang's army who were captured and eventually pardoned by
Marshal Feng Yu-hsiang arrived at the Shanghai North from
Nanking at 11 a.m. January 26. Immediately on arrival they
were taken to the Military Headquarters at Lunghwa and later
in the day released. These men, the majority of whom are
sick through long confinement and lack of nourishment, are now
being provided with food and lodging on premises attached to
the Russian Church, Chapei, at the expense of the local Russian
community.

公共租界警务处。
刑事调查处。

上海，1929年1月28日。

情报报告。
俄人类

张宗昌元帅军队中被俘并最终获冯玉祥元帅赦免的四十五名前俄国士兵，于1月26日上午11时从南京抵达上海北站。抵达后，他们立即被带往龙华军事总部，并于当日稍晚时候获释。这些人中大多数因长期监禁和缺乏营养而患病，目前由当地俄侨社区出资，在闸北俄罗斯教堂附属房舍内为他们提供食宿。

MUNICIPAL POLICE.
C. I. D.
Shanghai, January 28, 1929.

INTELLIGENCE REPORT.
Miscellaneous

Some thirty members of the Chinese Young Men's Lecturing
Group Society held a meeting between 10 and 11.30 a.m. Jan.
27, in their headquarters at Chung wen Road, Nantao, to
commemorate the 18th anniversary of the establishment of their
society. Dancing and musical entertainments were indulged
during
in the afternoon and evening by about 100 persons.

（印：OFFICE OF COMMISSIONER OF POLICE SHANGHAI JAN 29 1929）

（批：Duly）

上海，1929年1月28日。

情报报告。
杂项

中国青年演讲团社约三十名成员于1月27日上午10时至11时30分，在南市中文路（Chung wen Road，音译）该社总部举行会议，纪念该社成立十八周年。下午及晚间，约有一百人参加了舞会和音乐娱乐活动。

（印章：上海警务处处长办公室 1929年1月29日）
